sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 200. Success value 70. 3x to 6x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes damage reflection effects.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 30 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical and magic damage taken by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases light elemental defense by 80 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies resurrection.
Light Unison damage Ability Power boosted by 40 when equipped in the Main Slot.
